name: DYU A1F Pro Electric Bike
description: Meet the DYU A1F Pro - a clever little commuter that folds in seconds and fits under your desk. Its 250W brushless motor handles city gradients with ease, while the 36V battery delivers up to 45 km on a single charge. The lightweight aluminium frame tips the scales at just 22 kg, and integrated front and rear lights keep you visible after dark. A rear cargo rack adds practicality for shopping trips or work essentials.

name: ENGWE Engine X Electric Bike
description: Conquer any terrain with the ENGWE Engine X. This beast combines a punchy 250W motor with dual suspension and 20x4.0 inch fat tyres for supreme grip on sand, snow, or gravel. The 48V 13Ah battery takes you up to 100 km on a single charge, while the foldable frame means it stows neatly in your boot or hallway. Shimano 7-speed gears, an LCD dashboard, and a robust 150 kg load capacity make this an uncompromising all-rounder.

name: ENGWE EP-2 Boost Electric Bike
description: The original ENGWE EP-2 Boost that started it all. Built for riders who demand serious capability without the premium price tag. Its 500W motor powers through steep inclines, while the 48V 15Ah battery offers up to 100 km on a single charge. Fat tyres and front suspension absorb bumps with ease, and the folding mechanism lets you take it anywhere. Mechanical disc brakes provide dependable stopping power in all weather conditions.

name: Eleglide M1 Plus Electric Bike
description: Trusted engineering at a remarkable price. The Eleglide M1 Plus punches well above its weight with a smooth 250W motor, Shimano 7-speed gears, and hydraulic disc brakes usually reserved for pricier machines. Choose between 27.5-inch (21.7 kg) or 29-inch (22.8 kg) wheels to suit your riding style, and enjoy up to 100 km on a single charge. With a 120 kg load capacity and comfortable geometry, this is the smart choice for daily commutes and weekend explorations alike.

name: Duotts C29 Electric Bike
description: Trail-ready power meets everyday practicality in the Duotts C29. Sporting massive 29-inch wheels and a muscular 500W motor, it devours hills and rough tracks alike. The generous 48V 15Ah battery keeps you rolling for up to 80 km on a single charge. At 26.5 kg, it is solidly built yet nimble enough for weekend adventures. Front suspension and mechanical disc brakes inspire confidence whether you are navigating forest paths or suburban shortcuts.

name: DYU D3F Electric Bike
description: Tiny footprint, big personality. The DYU D3F folds down to fit under train seats or in tight cupboards, yet still packs a capable 250W motor and 36V 10Ah battery for journeys up to 40 km on a single charge. The 14-inch wheels keep the overall size minimal, while the lightweight frame makes carrying it upstairs a breeze. Ideal for last-mile commuters or students hopping between campuses.

name: Eleglide M2 Electric Bike
description: Go further, faster. The Eleglide M2 boasts an exceptional 125 km range on a single charge courtesy of its beefy 36V 15Ah battery - one of the longest in its class. A high-torque 250W motor paired with Shimano 21-speed gears tackles everything from flat cycle paths to steep country lanes. Hydraulic front suspension and hydraulic disc brakes deliver control and comfort mile after mile. At just 22 kg and with a 120 kg load capacity, it suits commuters and weekend explorers alike.

name: ENGWE T14 Electric Bike
description: Slim, stylish, and wallet-friendly. The ENGWE T14 is purpose-built for city streets, weighing in light enough to carry up a flight of stairs yet sturdy enough for daily use. Its 250W motor and 36V 10Ah battery deliver up to 50 km on a single charge - plenty for the average commute and back. LED lights front and rear, plus a comfort saddle, round out a package that proves practical cycling need not cost a fortune.

name: Duotts S26 Electric Bike
description: For those who refuse to compromise. The Duotts S26 delivers flagship performance with its formidable 750W motor and full-suspension chassis that soaks up roots, rocks, and potholes. Fat 26-inch tyres bite hard on loose surfaces, while the 48V 17.5Ah battery extends your adventures up to 90 km on a single charge. Hydraulic brakes bring you to a confident stop even on steep descents - this is a serious machine for serious riders.

name: Fiido D3 Pro
description: Small on price, big on convenience. The Fiido D3 Pro is one of the most compact Electric bikes on the market, folding down in moments and sliding easily into car boots or under office desks. The 250W motor handles gentle inclines, and the 36V 7.8Ah battery covers up to 35 km on a single charge - ideal for quick dashes around town. An LED display keeps you informed, while the ultra-light build makes it a joy to carry.

name: Touroll U1 Electric Bike
description: A true crossover. The Touroll U1 bridges the gap between rugged trail bike and nimble city cruiser. Its 350W motor offers punchy acceleration, while 26-inch tyres and front suspension smooth out uneven surfaces. The 36V 10Ah battery supplies up to 65 km on a single charge, and Shimano 7-speed gears let you fine-tune your effort on any gradient. Perfect for riders who want one bike that does everything.

name: ENGWE Engine Pro 2.0 Electric Bike
description: Unstoppable adventure starts here. The ENGWE Engine Pro 2.0 packs a mighty 750W motor and a massive 48V 16Ah battery that pushes your range up to 110 km on a single charge. Full suspension front and rear cushions every bump, while chunky fat tyres grip loose terrain with authority. Fold it flat for transport, unfold it for freedom - this is premium off-road capability that travels with you.

name: ENGWE L20 3.0 Boost
description: The workhorse of the family. With its step-through frame and sturdy cargo rack, the ENGWE L20 3.0 Boost makes school runs, shopping trips, and food deliveries effortless. The 350W motor and 48V 13Ah battery provide up to 80 km on a single charge, while puncture-resistant tyres minimise roadside hassle. Practical, reliable, and built to carry - this is everyday mobility done right.

name: Touroll B1 Electric Bike
description: City style meets electric efficiency. The Touroll B1 turns heads with its sleek, modern silhouette while delivering the reliable performance commuters need. Its 250W motor and 36V 10.4Ah battery combine for up to 60 km on a single charge. Integrated lights keep you visible round the clock, and 7-speed gears give you options on hilly routes. Comfort geometry means you arrive relaxed, not rattled.

name: Touroll J1 Electric Bike
description: Commuting redefined. The Touroll J1 combines a peppy 350W motor with a long-lasting 36V 12.8Ah battery for up to 75 km on a single charge - enough for a week of short trips without plugging in. Hydraulic brakes deliver precise, fade-free stopping, and a smart display keeps speed, distance, and battery level at a glance. When reliability and range matter most, the J1 delivers.

name: Touroll J1 ST Electric Bike
description: Hop on, hop off - no fuss. The Touroll J1 ST features a low step-through frame that makes mounting and dismounting a doddle, whatever you are wearing. Under the elegant exterior sits a 350W motor and 36V 12.8Ah battery good for up to 75 km on a single charge. A comfort saddle and integrated rear rack add everyday practicality, making this the go-to choice for relaxed, easy riding.

name: ENGWE EP-2 3.0 Boost Electric Bike
description: The flagship of the ENGWE range. The EP-2 3.0 Boost sets a new standard with its 75Nm torque sensor that delivers silky-smooth, natural pedal assist - a feature usually found on bikes costing twice as much. The 48V 13Ah battery powers you up to 120 km on a single charge, and rapid 3.5-hour fast charging means minimal downtime. Hydraulic disc brakes, 20x4.0 inch fat tyres, and smart app connectivity complete a package that folds flat for easy storage. This is Electric biking at its finest.
